notes: The media card always has a picture now. When a source publishes cover art you see the art; when it does not - YouTube in a browser never does - you get the gold cloud on black instead, turning while the track plays and holding still when…

It is the same cloud as the loading animation, from the same file and the same settings, so tuning the loader in Options tunes this with it. The card no longer changes shape depending on whether a picture happened to be available.
The cloud genuinely stops when paused rather than quietly redrawing itself forever. That also fixes the loader preview in the Loader Studio, which had the same behaviour.
